d:
FC Lorient delivered a massive upset by securing a hard-fought 1-0 victory over high-flying AS Monaco!
AS Monaco came into the match pushing to return to the top of the Ligue 1 table, but Lorient's resolute defence held firm through an intense first half. The defining moment came in the 61st minute when Noah Cadiou stepped up and calmly converted a crucial penalty to put FC Lorient ahead. Lorient defended heroically in the closing stages to seal a major win and deny Monaco the top spot!
